info.title: How the travel journal works
info.offline_h: Everything stays on the iPad first
info.offline: Whatever you write and the photos you add are saved on this iPad right away. The journal works without Internet, even after a restart.
info.photos: Take pictures with your iPhone or camera. Bring them into the Photos app on the iPad – from the iPhone by AirDrop, from the camera with the card reader – and edit them there. Then add the finished pictures to the journal: it takes the edited version with time and place and keeps its own smaller copy. The originals stay in the Photos app.
info.before_1: Wait until the Photos app has uploaded everything to iCloud.
info.before_2: Turn off iCloud Photos on the iPad (Settings → your name → iCloud → Photos). Choose to remove the photos from the iPad: they stay in iCloud and on your other devices, and the iPad has room again for the trip.
info.before_3: On board, turn on Low Data Mode for the ship’s Wi-Fi on both the iPad and the iPhone (Settings → Wi-Fi → the network → Low Data Mode). Then no device quietly uploads photos to iCloud.
info.before_4: Set the journal’s photo transfer to «Upload only».
info.internet: As soon as the iPad has Internet, the journal syncs by itself: at start, when the connection comes back, and every two minutes. Texts are small and always go along. Photos only go out from published footprints – one picture in a good size and a small preview, together about 0.5 to 1 MB per photo. Drafts and originals stay on the iPad.
info.mode_all: All photos: your published photos go out, and the other person’s photos come in. For home.
info.mode_upload: Upload only: your published photos go out, nothing comes in. For the trip – on board the other person’s photos come straight from their iPad.
info.mode_paused: Paused: only texts are exchanged, no photos. For a very slow or expensive connection.
info.local: On board the two iPads exchange their entries and photos directly, without any Internet: over the ship’s Wi-Fi or, if there is none, over a direct radio link while the iPads are close to each other. Nothing goes over the satellite. Keep Wi-Fi and Bluetooth turned on for this, even when you are not connected to a network.
info.home: Set the photo transfer back to «All photos» and turn iCloud Photos on again. The trip photos in the Photos app then go to iCloud over your Internet at home.
info.before_5: In each travel journal, choose the areas under «Offline map» and load them while you have Wi-Fi at home. On the way the map then shows them without Internet.

peer.no_secret: To connect the two iPads, open the journal once with an Internet connection.
